transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, um… thanks for seeing me. I guess I’m here because my eating has been getting a little out of hand sometimes. After late shifts, I’ll stop and get food, and then when I get home I’ll just… keep eating. Like a full takeout meal, then chips, sweets, whatever’s around the apartment. And afterward I’m kind of shocked by how much it ended up being. I don’t know if that’s the kind of thing you help with, but it’s been bothering me.
Do you usually feel guilty after these episodes of eating a lot?

Um… I’m not totally sure if I’d call it guilt every time. I mean, I don’t feel great about it afterward, but I also try not to beat myself up too much. It’s more like… embarrassment, maybe? Like, “Why did I do that again?” But I don’t know if that’s what you mean by guilty.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop eating or control how much you're eating during those episodes?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but on those nights it does feel kind of like I’m not fully in charge. I’ll be telling myself, “Okay, put it away now,” but then I’m still opening another container or grabbing something else, and it just keeps going until everything’s gone. If that makes sense.
Do you ever try to make up for the amount you ate during those episodes by doing something to counteract it, like exercising or vomiting?

Um… yeah, sometimes. I’m kind of embarrassed to say that. It’s not like every single time, but after I get home and I’ve eaten way too much takeout or snacks, I’ll go to the bathroom and… make myself throw up. I tell myself it’s so it doesn’t just sit in me or turn into weight. I know that probably sounds bad.
How often do these episodes of eating a lot and then making yourself throw up happen?

Um… it’s not every night or anything. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is. But since the move kind of settled down and I got into a routine, I’d say most weeks there’s at least one late night where I eat way more than I meant to, and then I… try to make up for it somehow. Sometimes that’s throwing up, sometimes I’ll skip breakfast, or make myself go on a really long run. Does that answer what you mean?
How often do you have episodes where you eat a lot and feel like you're not fully in charge, without then trying to make up for it by vomiting, exercising, or anything like that?

I’m not totally sure, honestly. Usually if it gets to that point, I end up doing something after, even if it’s just telling myself I’ll skip a meal or exercise more. There might be times where I just go to bed and feel awful about it, but I haven’t really kept track of those separately. I don’t know if that’s the kind of answer you’re looking for.
How often do you have episodes where you eat a lot and feel like you're not fully in charge, without doing anything to try to make up for it afterward?

I guess… yeah, there are some times where I don’t really do anything afterward. Not as often, I don’t think. But once I start on those nights, it’s like I’m sort of watching myself from the outside, telling myself to just put the food away, and my hands just keep opening containers until everything’s gone. Then I just feel awful and kind of stuck with it. Is that what you mean?
How often do you have these episodes where you eat a lot and feel out of control without doing anything to make up for it afterward?

I’m not sure I can give you a clean number. I haven’t really been separating those out in my head. I think it happens sometimes, but less than the times where I do try to “fix” it afterward. Maybe I should start keeping track, if that would be helpful?
How many times a month do you have episodes where you eat a lot and feel out of control without doing anything to make up for it afterward?

I honestly don’t know the exact number. I’m sorry—I know you’re asking for something more specific. I’d say it’s not a lot, maybe just a few times, but I haven’t been tracking which times I do something afterward and which times I don’t. If it helps, I can start keeping count.
Do these episodes where you eat a lot and feel out of control without doing anything to make up for it happen at least once a week?

I’m not totally sure… I don’t want to guess wrong. My sense is probably not every week, or at least I haven’t noticed it that regularly. It’s kind of blurry because I wasn’t separating those from the other times in my head. Is it okay if I say I’m not sure?
Do these episodes of eating a lot and feeling out of control, without doing anything to make up for it, happen more than three times a month?

I don’t think it’s more than three times a month… but I’m not completely confident. I feel a little bad that I haven’t been keeping track the right way. My best answer is probably no, not more than three, but I’d want to watch it more closely so I’m not misleading you.
Do these episodes of eating a lot and feeling out of control, without doing anything to make up for it, happen at least once a month?

I’m… I’m not sure. I want to be helpful, but I haven’t been keeping track that specifically. It might happen once in a month sometimes, but I don’t want to say yes like it’s definite if I’m not sure. If that’s okay, I’d say I haven’t noticed it clearly enough to give you a solid answer.
Do you think these episodes of eating a lot and feeling out of control, without doing anything to make up for it, happen at least once a month most months?

I wish I could give you a cleaner answer. I don’t think I’ve noticed it happening most months, at least not in a way I can say for sure. I’m sorry, I know that’s probably not as helpful as a yes or no… but I’d be guessing a little.
Do you think there's even one month in the past year where you didn't have any of these episodes of eating a lot and feeling out of control?

I… actually, I think I may have been answering that too narrowly before. Since the apartment move settled down and I got into a routine, it’s been most weeks that I’ll have at least one late-night time where I eat way more than I meant to and feel like I can’t really stop.

And, um… I usually do try to make up for it after, like throwing up, or skipping breakfast, or making myself go for a long run. I’m sorry, I know that changes how I said it before. I guess I was embarrassed and trying to answer it in the least bad-sounding way.
Do you have episodes where you eat a lot and feel out of control without doing anything to make up for it more than once a week?

I’m not totally sure about the “more than once a week” part. I know there are weeks where it happens, but if you mean specifically times where I don’t do anything afterward to make up for it… I haven’t really tracked that clearly. I don’t want to overstate it just to give an answer that sounds neat.
Do you have episodes where you eat a lot and feel out of control without doing anything to make up for it at least once a week?

I don’t know if I can honestly say at least once every week when it’s specifically without doing anything afterward. Some weeks, yes, I think that happens… but I’m not sure it’s consistent enough for me to say weekly without guessing. Does that make sense?
Do you have episodes where you eat a lot and feel out of control without doing anything to make up for it, such as throwing up or exercising, at least a few times a month?

A few times a month… yeah, I think that’s probably fair. I’m a little uncomfortable saying it, but there are definitely times where I eat too much and feel out of control, and then I don’t really do anything afterward to make up for it. It’s not every time, but a few times a month sounds right, I think.
Do you have episodes where you eat a lot and feel out of control without doing anything to make up for it, such as throwing up or exercising, at least once a month for the past 3 months?

I’m not totally sure how to answer that cleanly. I mean, I know it’s happened in that general way, but saying “at least once a month for the past 3 months” feels like I’d be pretending I kept better track than I did. I don’t want to give you a wrong answer just to be agreeable.
Do you have episodes where you eat a lot and feel out of control without doing anything to make up for it, at least once a month?

Yeah… I think at least once a month is probably true. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but on those nights, once I start, it feels like I’m kind of watching myself do it. I’ll be thinking, “Just put it away,” but I keep opening things and eating until it’s gone. Does that answer what you mean?
Do you have episodes where you eat a lot and feel out of control without doing anything to make up for it, such as throwing up or exercising, every week?

Every week… I don’t know if I can honestly say that. I mean, it happens sometimes, like I said, but weekly feels maybe too strong. I haven’t really tracked it that closely, and I don’t want to exaggerate it. I’d say it’s more occasional than every week, if that makes sense.
